summary: Configured node1 to run inventory maintenance daily at 02:15 and append all output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Native BusyBox cron is enabled and running. Configuration and log data survived a verified node restart; the OS release and kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the log with root ownership and mode 0640.
Enabled and started the existing Alpine `crond` service without installing or upgrading software.
Verified output append behavior before and after restarting node1.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.

evidence.requirement: Run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retain its output
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 02:15 schedule, active and enabled crond, and successfully appended output in the requested log before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-restart evidence show Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 61600913-2f64-409e-96d2-0e334230150e; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to d6ea975a-c114-4c7e-97f0-d600891e2ad3; cron, schedule, and retained log data recovered.
